english.title: Leave / park / cause a vehicle to wait in excess of the permitted waiting period at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[left or parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to wait]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), to which the road traffic enactments do not apply, at Stansted Airport London for a period in excess of the permitted time in an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), where the period of waiting was restricted by a sign
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(3) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
left / parked a vehicle / caused a vehicle to wait
at a location to which the road traffic enactments do not apply
at Stansted Airport London
for a period in excess of the permitted time
in an area where the period of waiting
is restricted by a sign

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
